hallucination.evidence: Unsupported: 0 — all concrete claims (195 m², 1990s, brick facade, south-facing, tile flooring, fireplace, wood cabinetry, tile splashback, freestanding range, breakfast nook, patio, cellar, driveway) supported by inputs.
